issue.standard_remedy: Route off-contract buying to contracted suppliers
issue.summary: 62% of category spend is off contract

plan.diagnosis: 62% of Plastic resins category spend ($5,783,599 of $9,318,219 total) is maverick spend occurring off-contract across 9 plants in a direct materials category. This high leakage indicates absence of enforced sourcing controls in a multi-ERP environment (SAP, Oracle EBS, Dynamics 365, NetSuite, Coupa) and likely decentralized purchasing behavior bypassing the $3,534,619 contracted baseline.

remedy_steps.step: Immediately identify all contracted Plastic resins suppliers and their agreements; map which ERPs and plants are covered by each contract and validate pricing/terms are loaded

Implement source list restrictions and purchase order blocks across all 5 ERP systems to permit Plastic resins purchases only from contracted suppliers; configure catalog punchouts in Coupa for approved sources

Conduct plant-by-plant workshops (all 9 facilities) to communicate contracted suppliers, pricing, and ordering process; collect feedback on any legitimate gaps in contract coverage or material specifications
Establish weekly maverick spend monitoring dashboard fed by all ERP systems; assign plant controllers to review and challenge any off-contract POs before approval
Negotiate contract amendments or new agreements to close any legitimate supplier or specification gaps identified; target 95% contract coverage

plan.expected_impact: Redirecting 90% of the $5,783,599 maverick spend to contracted suppliers at an estimated 8-12% price improvement will yield $416,419 to $624,628 in annual savings.
kpis: Contract compliance rate (target: increase from 38% to 95% within 90 days)
Maverick spend USD (target: reduce from $5,783,599 to below $466,000)
Number of active Plastic resins suppliers (track consolidation)
Average unit price variance: contracted vs. maverick purchases
PO compliance: % of Plastic resins POs created against source lists
risks: Production disruption if contracted suppliers cannot fulfill demand across all 9 plants or lack required material grades
User resistance and workarounds if ERP restrictions are too rigid without exception process
Contract supplier capacity constraints leading to delivery delays during transition
Multi-ERP technical implementation complexity causing delays or inconsistent controls across systems
Hidden reasons for maverick spend (quality issues, lead times, local requirements) not surfaced until after restrictions imposed
erp_actions: SAP: Activate source list requirement (ME01) for all Plastic resins material masters; set indicator '1' in material master (MAT_GRP); apply vendor posting blocks (LFA1-SPERM) for non-contracted suppliers in plastic resins category
Oracle EBS: Create approved supplier list (ASL) entries for contracted vendors; enable 'Use Approved Supplier' flag on Plastic resins items; restrict requisition creation to catalog items
Dynamics 365: Configure trade agreements for contracted Plastic resins suppliers; enable purchase agreement policy rules; set up procurement category policies to require purchase agreements

NetSuite: Build item records with preferred vendor assignment for all Plastic resins; enable 'Use Item Preferred Vendor' in procurement preferences; restrict vendor bill entry for non-approved suppliers in category

Coupa: Create supplier catalog punchouts for contracted Plastic resins vendors; configure category-based approval workflows requiring justification for non-catalog purchases; enable contract compliance reporting
